changes.to: Maker hardware manual (JAKA K1, V01): a 7-axis dual-arm collaborative platform - per arm 5 kg payload, 14 kg mass, 976 mm working radius, repeatability +/-0.05 mm, TCP max 1 m/s, 48 V DC supply, RoboHub controller with Intel Core i12/i13 CPU, EtherCAT. Dual-arm synchronised control (SyncPath, SyncForce, SyncCalib, SelfAware). DoF field left empty because the maker states 7 axes per arm, not a whole-body count; no height, weight or runtime for a complete robot is published. SCOPE: K1 has no mobile base - it is a bench-mounted dual-arm platform, which AGENTS.md section 3 excludes as arms/cobots; kept here unchanged (no deletion) and flagged for an owner scope decision. The wheeled K1W and legged K1L are separate models.
JAKA RoboHub controller (Intel Core i3/i5/i7 12th-13th gen, optional NVIDIA RTX 3050)
JAKA's K1 seven-axis dual-arm platform for dual-arm assembly and embodied-AI data collection.
